description: Issue #49, second half, as Issue #182 re-decided it: the issue itself writes both "web/src/lib/filter.ts" and the shorter "src/lib/filter.ts", and at most one is the file it means. The planner used to drop the shorter one — the guess "the longer path wins" — and report it. It no longer guesses: both stay in suspected_files and it asks which was meant (`ambiguous_file_candidate`), which is a QUESTION and therefore stops dispatch, where the old warning did not. What #49 established is still pinned here — the shorter path is a real candidate rather than an invention of the extraction, and it is present because the body wrote it, not because a `\b` match manufactured it out of the longer one (case 18 covers that direction). The measured shape where the DECLARED path was the one dropped is 57-shadowed-path-is-a-question.
